app.name: Employee Portal
app.demoBanner: Demo · Sample data. Do not upload real VPN profiles.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Use your corporate Microsoft account.
signin.mockHint: Choose a sample user. VPN profiles are non-working examples.
signin.mockDenied: This user has no portal role, so no session was created.
signin.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
signin.notConfigured: Microsoft sign-in is not configured yet.
signin.demoSubtitle: Explore the employee dashboard and administration without SSO.

denied.title: No access
denied.noRole: Your account signed in successfully, but it has not been granted access to the portal.
denied.failed: Sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
denied.contact: If you think you should have access, contact IT support.

home.intro: Here you can get the work tools that IT has prepared for you.
home.vpnCardText: Download your VPN configurations and set up the client on your computer or phone.

vpn.title: VPN
vpn.intro: Download your configurations and follow the steps for your device.

vless.title: Xray / VLESS
vless.description: Alternative connection that works where regular VPN is blocked.

wg.title: WireGuard
wg.description: The old VPN. Use it only if IT asked you to.

vpn.qrHint: Scan this code in the VPN app on your phone.
vpn.maskedHint: The link is hidden. Showing it is logged.
vpn.emptyText: IT hasn't prepared a VPN configuration for you yet. If you need VPN access, contact IT support.
vpn.instructionsFallback: This guide isn't translated yet — showing the English version.

errors.not_found: This configuration is no longer available. Refresh the page.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Try again or contact IT support.

overview.pendingHint: Imported, but nobody with that key has signed in yet.
overview.quarantineHint: Rejected files to fix or delete.

import.intro: Upload config files named '<owner>__<type>__<label>.<ext>' (Pritunl .tar exports and .csv manifests work too). You'll see a preview before anything is saved.
import.drop: Drop files here or click to choose
import.selected: {count, plural, one {# file selected} other {# files selected}}
import.commit: Import {count, plural, one {# config} other {# configs}}
import.nothingToDo: Nothing to import — everything is unchanged.

errors.stale_preview: The files changed since the preview. Preview again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many uploads. Wait a few minutes.
errors.batch_too_large: Upload is too large (20 MB max).

configs.noContentAccess: Admins can manage configs but can't download other people's files.
configs.replaceHint: To replace a config, import a new file with the same owner, type and label.
configs.deleteText: All versions are destroyed for good (crypto-shredded). The employee loses access immediately. This can't be undone.
configs.rollbackText: The employee will get this version on their next download.
configs.orphanedHint: The owner key now points at someone else (or nobody). This config stays with the person shown and is invisible to the new key holder. Delete it, and import new files for the new owner.

users.removeText: Configs with this key stop being visible to this user until the key is linked again.
users.move: If the key belongs to someone else, move it (they lose those configs)

unlinked.title: Waiting for owner
unlinked.intro: Configs whose owner key isn't linked to anyone. Usually a new employee who hasn't signed in yet — or a typo in the file name. Link the key to a person to make the configs visible to them.
unlinked.old: older than 14 days — check for a typo

users.revokeText: All their sessions end now. Use it right after removing someone's role in Entra; otherwise their current session lasts until it expires.

quarantine.intro: Files the importer rejected. They are kept encrypted for 30 days. Fix the owner/type/label to accept a file, or delete it. If the content itself is broken, delete it and import a corrected file.
quarantine.deleteText: The encrypted copy is destroyed for good.

audit.exportHint: Exports up to 50,000 rows with the current filters.

result.alias_taken: Key “{key}” already belongs to {upn}. Tick “move” to reassign it.
result.no_content: This file has no stored content — delete it and import again.
result.no_reactivate: There is no version to reactivate.
result.alias_saved_kept: Key “{key}” now belongs to {upn}. {kept} existing config(s) stay with the previous owner — import new files for {upn}.
result.self_assign: Admins can't assign owner keys or quarantined files to themselves.
result.owner_locked: The owner was read from the file name and can't be changed here — only type and label.

reasons.name_bad_owner_key: Owner key may contain only letters, digits, . - _
reasons.name_bad_label: Label may contain only letters, digits, . - _
reasons.name_extension_mismatch: Extension doesn't match the config type
reasons.vless_bad_uuid: vless:// link has no valid UUID
reasons.vless_bad_port: vless:// link has no valid port
reasons.vless_expected_one_link: File must contain exactly one vless:// link
reasons.pritunl_no_header: Not a Pritunl download (no profile header with user and server). Rename it '<owner>__pritunl__<label>.ovpn' or accept it with an owner below
reasons.pritunl_owner_mismatch: The Pritunl profile inside belongs to a different user than the owner in the file name. Delete it and upload the right file
reasons.manifest_too_many_rows: CSV manifest has too many rows
reasons.manifest_empty_value: Manifest row has no content or file name
reasons.manifest_file_not_found: Manifest refers to a file that isn't in this upload
reasons.owner_ambiguous: Owner key is ambiguous or its automatic alias is outdated; verify the recipient in Users.
reasons.duplicate_in_batch: Same owner/type/label twice in this upload
reasons.manifest_file_reused: A manifest refers to the same file twice
